The **enriched** tier is the intermediate enrichment stage of Pipeline B. It is the output of
`enrich.py` and the input to `classifier.py`. It is kept in-repo for traceability — most users
should use the curated [hierarchical per-class files](index.qmd) instead.

## What it is

`adm0`–`adm4.geojson` — the full NAMRIA polygon set at each administrative level, with each
polygon annotated with its `psgc_code`, `psgc_name`, `psgc_status`, and `match_confidence`.

::: {.callout-note}
Intermediate pipeline stage — most users want the curated
[hierarchical per-class files](index.qmd) instead.
:::

## File inventory

Kept in-repo at `2023-10-24/enriched_t0p005/` for traceability:

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `adm0.geojson`–`adm4.geojson` | NAMRIA polygons at each admin level, each annotated with `psgc_code`, `psgc_name`, `psgc_status`, and `match_confidence` |
| `diff.json` | PSGC-vs-NAMRIA reconciliation diff (matches, gaps, mismatches) |
| `summary.md` | human-readable summary of the enrichment pass |

`adm3` mixes municipalities **and** cities because this stage is **pre-classification** — features
are not yet split by city class. The classifier + splitter (see
[Pipeline B](../toolchain/pipeline-geo.qmd)) separate them into the curated per-class files.

## Download (in-repo)

Fetch a single file via `raw.githubusercontent.com`:

```bash
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/main/2023-10-24/enriched_t0p005/adm4.geojson
```

How enrichment works (name normalization + HUC mapping + fuzzy match) is documented in
[Pipeline B](../toolchain/pipeline-geo.qmd); the HUC reconciliation in
[HUC mapping](../references/huc-mapping.qmd); the `match_confidence` values (`exact` / `huc_map` /
`fuzzy`) in [feature properties](properties.qmd).
